name: Water Wise
description: Use trail observations and simple ratios to plan a safe desert walk.

steps.description: Inspect the trail marker and plan the return route.
Inspect the old crate and scavenge spot without taking unsafe junk.
Calculate that 2 liters at 250 ml per hour lasts 8 hours.
Compare useful plant samples as a ratio.
Choose the safest desert heat plan.

reward.label: Water management
reward.childMessage: You planned water, shade, and route before wandering farther.
